activity.notes: Tito headed the joint Provisional Government of Democratic Federal Yugoslavia from its formation on 7 March 1945 until the monarchy was abolished and the Federal People's Republic of Yugoslavia was proclaimed on 29 November 1945. ATLAS separates this constitutional phase from the subsequent FPRY.

sources.title: Dignitaries — Archives of Yugoslavia
sources.citation_text: The Archives of Yugoslavia lists Josip Broz Tito as head of government from 7 March 1945.

sources.title: Constituent Acts of Yugoslavia — Archives of Yugoslavia
sources.citation_text: The Archives documents the constitutional transformation of Yugoslavia and the later state-name changes.
